Incredible little restaurant with delicious food
Jul 2023 • Solo
I found this little restaurant today and decided to try it. I have travelled extensively through Sth East Asia (SEA) and for the price of their meals this is the best restaurant for western food I have eaten at in 20 years of travelling in SEA.

It was a hot day but with the fans on it was quite pleasant sitting there. Lady who owns it was there to greet me and gave me their menu. The menu has a mix of western and asian meals.

I ordered a caesar salad with anchovy sauce as a starter and a chicken parmigiana stuffed with ham and cheese and an egg on top (this came covered in their home made sauce which was delicious).

The salad was really good with everything fresh and is big enough to be a meal in itself. Finely sliced cucumber in the salad was unusual but suited it perfectly.

The stuffed chicken parmigiana was delicious and quite large. I would suggest being careful not to over order here as the meal servings I had were large.

This will be my goto place for my lunches or dinners while I am in Vung Tau and I hope to try out a lot of the menu.

Of special note, the owner has good english and they waited for me to finish the salad before feshly cooking my main meal. This is quite a rarity as almost always if you order a starter in SEA with a main meal they will come to your table together. Very much appreciated this.

I think this restaurant is very good value for money. An excellent experience overall and highly recommended.

Jan 2022 • Family
I am RE-reviewing this place - something I have not done on any of my other reviews. This because the latest visit was simply nasty. I mentioned in my first review that they allow indoor smoking - but I had hoped it was a one off.

Yesterday I visited for dinner with my 2 yr old toddler and my wife. The table beside us was pudding smoke into my child’s lungs ( and ours) and the restaurant staff didn’t help at all when I told them . So we moved tables to avoid the smoke . The table beside us 4 adults then all lit their cigarettes and we nearly choked . Do not go there is you don’t want to Inhale someone’s smoke!

Next we asked for a very small amount of plain pasta for our toddler - we offered even to pay for it ( she can’t eat an adult size dish but still we were happy to pay for a full price ) - we were told they won’t cook it !!! Even if we pay!! - they wouldn’t even boil some simple pasta ( no sauce) for a child! - 

The waitress and the owner simply didn’t care . My kid sat and did not eat- breathed carbon monoxide whilst we sat and ate some rather nasty food .

The place is also musky and smells -

We will not be back .

Really Nice Food
Dec 2021
We went to Yummy Yummy a few nights ago, the first restaurant meal I have had since lockdown ended. I have to admit I was a bit uneasy when I got there as it was the location where I got a bad meal and worse service before when it was under a different name.
I need not have worried as meals we were presented with were excellent. Our party was 4 people and I ordered the Black Angus Fillet steak. The other 3 ordered Ribs.
My steak was done to perfection and was really delicious, tender and juicy, the black pepper cream sauce was equally delicious as were the fries.
The ribs that the other three had were also looking delicious and I tried a bit to be sure.
The menu is extensive and you will find something to satisfy everybody.
I think that it was as good as any restaurant I have eaten in Vung Tau.
The service was also very good and thats important too.
Yummy Yummy has moved to this new location and is in a small side street but worth finding. 
We will be back there soon again.
